about: Hand-written (passage, quote, claim) cases for the grounding gate, written for this repo. The passages are invented product listings, policies, notices and short factual statements, not copied from anywhere. hard marks a near-miss (most of the quote's words kept, meaning changed) and was set when the case was written, before the gate was run.

passages.P01: The Ridgeline 2P tent weighs 1.6 kg and packs to 45 x 15 cm. It is on sale for $249, down from $329. Free returns within 30 days of delivery.
passages.P02: Python 3.12 removed the distutils package, which had been deprecated since Python 3.10.
passages.P03: The museum is open Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 17:00. It is closed on Mondays and on 25 December. Admission is free for visitors under 18.
passages.P04: In the trial, 412 participants received the vaccine and 405 received a placebo. Efficacy against symptomatic infection was 71% after two doses.
passages.P05: The Northline bus runs every 15 minutes on weekdays and every 30 minutes on weekends. The last departure from Central Station is at 23:40.
passages.P06: The K2 Maysis boot ships in US sizes 7 through 13 and uses a Boa closure. It is not available in wide widths.
passages.P07: The library lends up to 12 items per card for 21 days. Items can be renewed twice unless another member has placed a hold.
passages.P08: Our API allows 600 requests per minute per key. Requests over the limit receive HTTP 429 and should be retried after the Retry-After interval.
passages.P09: Marta Lindqvist joined the company in 2019 as head of research. She previously led the imaging group at Uppsala University for six years.
passages.P10: The water heater has a 50-gallon tank and a 4500 W element. Recovery rate is 21 gallons per hour at a 90 F temperature rise.
passages.P11: Applications for the Summer 2027 internship close on 15 January 2027. Applicants must be enrolled in a degree program at the time of the internship.
passages.P12: The recipe serves four. Bake at 180 C for 35 to 40 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
passages.P13: The study found that the new model improved recall to 0.84 while precision fell from 0.91 to 0.88.
passages.P14: Standard shipping within Canada takes 3 to 5 business days. International orders ship by courier and take 7 to 14 business days.
passages.P15: The board approved a dividend of 0.42 per share, payable on 12 March to shareholders of record on 28 February.
passages.P16: The bridge will be closed to cars from 1 June to 30 September for deck repairs. Pedestrians and cyclists can still cross on the east sidewalk.
passages.P17: Firmware 2.4 adds support for WPA3 and fixes a bug that drained the battery in standby. It does not change the Bluetooth stack.
passages.P18: Patients may experience mild headache or nausea in the first week. Severe reactions are rare and occurred in fewer than 1 in 1,000 patients in trials.
passages.P19: The apartment has two bedrooms, one bathroom and a balcony facing the courtyard. Rent is 1,850 per month; heat and water are included, electricity is not.
passages.P20: Version 5 of the library drops support for Node 16. Node 18 or newer is required.
passages.P21: The survey of 1,200 adults found that 38% had used a generative AI tool at work in the past month. The margin of error is plus or minus 3 points.
passages.P22: The ferry departs Horseshoe Bay at 07:20 and arrives at Departure Bay at 09:00. Reservations are recommended on summer weekends.
passages.P23: Cast iron pans should be dried immediately after washing and lightly oiled. Do not put them in the dishwasher.
passages.P24: The 2026 model weighs 13.2 kg without pedals and has a 12-speed drivetrain. The frame is aluminium; the fork is carbon.
passages.P25: Students who complete at least 80% of the labs may be eligible for a certificate. Certificates are issued within 30 days of the course end date.
passages.P26: The council voted 7 to 2 to approve the bike lane on Elm Street. Construction is expected to start next spring, pending funding.
passages.P27: The laptop has 16 GB of RAM, soldered to the board, and a 512 GB SSD that can be replaced. Battery life is rated at up to 14 hours of video playback.
passages.P28: The hotel's pool is open from May to September. Pets under 10 kg are welcome for a fee of 25 per night.
passages.P29: The Rust 2024 edition was stabilised in Rust 1.85, released in February 2025.
passages.P30: Lab results are usually available within 48 hours. Results that need a specialist review can take up to a week.
passages.P31: The coffee is a single-origin washed Ethiopian, roasted light. Tasting notes: jasmine, lemon, black tea.
passages.P32: The parental leave policy gives birth parents 17 weeks of paid leave and other parents 8 weeks. Leave must be taken within 12 months of the birth or adoption.
passages.P33: The model was trained on 2.1 million labelled images and evaluated on a held-out set of 50,000. Top-1 accuracy on the held-out set was 82.4%.
passages.P34: Tickets are refundable up to 48 hours before the show. After that, they can be exchanged for another date but not refunded.
passages.P35: Kettle Lake is 4.2 km long and reaches a maximum depth of 38 m. Swimming is allowed at the north beach; motorboats are prohibited.
passages.P36: The startup raised 12 million in a Series A led by Northwind Ventures. Existing investors Halcyon and Bramble also participated.
passages.P37: To reset the router, hold the reset button for 10 seconds until the light blinks amber. This erases all custom settings.
passages.P38: The paper reports a 23% reduction in hospital readmissions among patients enrolled in the program, compared with a matched control group. The study was observational.
passages.P39: The phone is rated IP68: dust-tight and protected against immersion in 1.5 m of fresh water for up to 30 minutes.
passages.P40: Registration for the spring session opens on 3 March. Members get one week of early access before registration opens to the public.
passages.P41: The software is free for personal use. Commercial use requires a licence, priced at 99 per seat per year.
passages.P42: The trail is 11 km return with 600 m of elevation gain. Dogs must be on a leash. The upper section is closed from November to April because of avalanche risk.
passages.P43: The update to the privacy policy takes effect on 1 May. We will no longer share location data with advertising partners.
passages.P44: The gallery is accessible by elevator from the main lobby. Wheelchairs are available to borrow at the front desk free of charge.
passages.P45: During the outage, about 18% of requests in the eu-west region failed for 42 minutes. No data was lost.
passages.P46: The scholarship covers tuition for up to four years. It does not cover housing or textbooks.
passages.P47: The vacuum's battery lasts about 60 minutes on eco mode and 12 minutes on max. A full charge takes 4 hours.
passages.P48: The contract renews automatically for one-year terms unless either party gives 60 days' written notice before the renewal date.
passages.P49: Mount Robson is the highest peak in the Canadian Rockies at 3,954 m. The first confirmed ascent was in 1913.
passages.P50: The cafe uses oat milk by default. Dairy milk is available on request at no extra charge; almond milk costs 0.50 more.
passages.P51: The election turnout was 61.3%, up from 58.0% four years earlier. The incumbent won with 47% of the vote.
passages.P52: The warranty covers manufacturing defects for two years from the date of purchase. It does not cover water damage or normal wear.
